note: Kearny County parcels are only reachable through the state ORKA property viewer (apps.kansasgis.org/orka; Experience app a40d598785b3424a8a672d5d080823f9). Its webmap and ORKA service folders expose no Kearny parcel polygon layer (KS_ORKA_Extras holds city limits, subdivisions and lots; ORKA_Extras_VTI2 is a generic tile index; wimas holds water-right points). ORKA parcel data is obtained via a request page, not a public queryable service. Commercial sites (Acres, AcreValue, Regrid) are not county sources.
